description: A flower field along water, surrounded by mountains to the north west and north east
notes: 'Along water': a shoreline along the south edge (20% of the map is sea); the flower field runs along it across the south half.
Mountains: two large, high massifs in the north-west and north-east, too steep to climb, like the border cliffs.
No village, no road: the description asks for none.
Phase 7b: low cliffs (25 m) with a boulder rim around an organic play area (the defaults).
name: Mapgen Flowers
